voice: Cracked, patient old Lahori Punjabi; the source of Daya's accent; sings when she thinks nobody listens

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Narrow face, high cheekbones, deep wrinkles, a sunken mouth (missing teeth), slightly cloudy left eye

skin.description: Fair-wheatish, deeply lined; age spots on the hands; slightly cloudy left eye
skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

groom.hair: White, long, braided and pinned under a chunni

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: White cotton salwar kameez; white chunni over the head
outfits.monsoon: White cotton suit; plastic sandals; a cotton shawl
outfits.winter: White suit; thick woollen shawl; woollen socks; a hand-knit cardigan
outfits.by_act: Same wardrobe in every act; she wears white because she is a widow and she does not change it

accessories: Wooden walking stick; thick-framed glasses on a cord; a small prayer book in a cloth; a steel kada; a transistor radio
tells: Calls the boy by his grandfather's name when tired; hums a Kasur lullaby
gait_notes: Short shuffling steps, one hand on the stick and the other on a wall or shoulder; sits down in stages; stands up with a grunt and a joke
sensitivity: Respected elder; head covering is correct and consistent; never played for pity.
